programme.name: Social Sciences, with an Emphasis in Psychology (BA)

courses.title: MATH 218 or MATH 265 may substitute for MATH 114
courses.source_line: *MATH 208 , MATH 218 or MATH 265 may substitute for MATH 114 .

notes.text: The required courses are: PSYC 100 , MATH 114 *, PSYC 274L and eight upper-division courses in departments in the social sciences, including five in the Department of Psychology and three outside the department but within the division. These may be any 300- or 400-numbered courses.
